references.text: God commands Moses to go up on Mount Abarim to see the land he will not enter
Moses goes up on Mount Pisgah and sees the whole land from the top before he dies, as God had said
God explains why Moses is not allowed to lead the people into the promised land because of his unbelief at Meribah
God repeats the command that Moses must go up on the mountain to see the land, but not cross the Jordan
Moses says that the Lord was angry with him for the people's sake and refused to let him enter the land
Moses reiterates that he will die in this land and not cross the Jordan, while the people will go over and take possession of the good land
